links.comparator_used: Base model (Gemini 2.5 Flash) without the curated knowledge base, and eight commercial LLMs (and three frontier LLMs in Study 2) answering from their training knowledge alone
links.outcome: Modal accuracy on 99 binary dental traumatology questions; valid rationale rate; confabulated rationales; specialist rubric score
links.effect: Modal accuracy 96.0% (95% CI 90.1-98.4) vs best commercial comparator GPT-5.5 87.9% (paired difference +8.1 pp, 95% CI +2.9 to +14.9; p_Holm = 0.013). Valid rationale rate 49.5% to 98.0% for the base model with the knowledge base; confabulations 0 vs 21. Study 2: 82.1/92 vs Claude Opus 4.5 72.6 (+9.6 points, exact Wilcoxon p = 0.016), Gemini 2.5 Pro 60.3, GPT-4.1 50.4; all seven evaluators ranked DT-RAG first (Kendall's W = 0.97).
links.quote: The curated knowledge base elevated the base model from 49.5% to 98.0% valid rationale rate, eliminating confabulations in this evaluation (0 vs 21).

design_hint: curated retrieval grounding added to base LLM
